title: Twelve More Issuers Lift OKXICE Objections to 50
why_it_matters: The 32% increase since the prior notice further narrows OKXICE's proposed roster and shows how issuer-level opt-outs can shape which tokenized equities reach a venue.
caption:
RWA WIRE // REGULATION

Twelve More Issuers Lift OKXICE Objections to 50

OKXICE's October 30 notice adds 12 issuers, including Nvidia, Nike, Costco and Reddit, increasing objections to its proposed tokenized-stock venue from 38 to 50.
